title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — General Assessment #6

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A leaking pipe wastes 5 litres each day. How much is wasted in 7 days? (1 mark)
   A. 35 litres
   B. 12 litres
   C. 57 litres
   D. 70 litres

2. Why do we wash vegetables in a basin? (1 mark)
   A. It uses less water and the water can be reused
   B. It makes them heavier
   C. It makes them cold
   D. It wastes water

3. Which part of a plant makes fruits and seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Leaf
   B. Flower
   C. Stem
   D. Root

4. What does deworming do? (1 mark)
   A. Cleans teeth
   B. Cures a cough
   C. Makes food taste better
   D. Kills worms in the intestines

5. How many legs does an insect have? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Ten
   C. Six
   D. Eight

6. Which of these is true of a gas? (1 mark)
   A. It has no fixed shape and no fixed volume
   B. It is always visible
   C. It cannot spread out
   D. It keeps its own shape

7. Which of these gives the young plant its first food before its leaves open? (1 mark)
   A. The bark
   B. The seed
   C. The flower
   D. The wind

8. What is heat? (1 mark)
   A. A type of gas
   B. A kind of matter
   C. A form of energy that makes things hot
   D. A kind of sound

9. Which of these is NOT a job of the roots? (1 mark)
   A. Taking in water
   B. Holding the plant in the soil
   C. Making fruit
   D. Storing food in some plants

10. Which of these reduces water use when brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Using a hose
   B. Using a bucket of water
   C. Using a cup of water
   D. Leaving the tap running

11. Which of these is NOT a part of the digestive system? (1 mark)
   A. Rectum
   B. Gullet
   C. Stomach
   D. Lungs

12. What should you do when you have a persistent stomach ache? (1 mark)
   A. Tell an adult and see a health worker
   B. Drink dirty water
   C. Eat more sweets
   D. Hide it

13. Which of these is a way to save water when bathing? (1 mark)
   A. Leave the tap open
   B. Use a sprinkler
   C. Use a basin
   D. Use a hose

14. Where does digestion finish and digested food pass into the blood? (1 mark)
   A. Small intestine
   B. Mouth
   C. Rectum
   D. Stomach

15. Why should kitchen gloves be dry? (1 mark)
   A. Dry cloth is colder
   B. Dry cloth is heavier
   C. Wet cloth is thicker
   D. Wet cloth passes heat quickly

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give three safety measures to observe when cooking. (3 marks)

17. State two reasons for conserving water. (2 marks)

18. Describe how you can show that rough surfaces give more friction than smooth ones. (3 marks)

19. State three ways of keeping teeth healthy. (3 marks)

20. Explain why sorting waste is important for reusing and recycling. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — 35 litres
   5 x 7 = 35 litres.

2. A — It uses less water and the water can be reused
   A basin limits water use and allows reuse.

3. B — Flower
   Flowers make fruits that contain seeds.

4. D — Kills worms in the intestines
   Deworming tablets kill worms living in the intestines.

5. C — Six
   All adult insects have six legs.

6. A — It has no fixed shape and no fixed volume
   A gas spreads to fill the space.

7. B — The seed
   The seed contains stored food that feeds the young plant at first.

8. C — A form of energy that makes things hot
   Heat is a form of energy.

9. C — Making fruit
   Fruits are made from flowers, not by roots.

10. C — Using a cup of water
   A cup uses only a little water.

11. D — Lungs
   Lungs are for breathing.

12. A — Tell an adult and see a health worker
   Adults and health workers can help find the cause.

13. C — Use a basin
   Using a basin limits the water used.

14. A — Small intestine
   The small intestine completes digestion and absorbs food into the blood.

15. D — Wet cloth passes heat quickly
   Wet cloth can burn your hand.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Use gloves, turn handles inwards, keep children away, do not play with matches, keep paraffin away from fire.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: To have enough water for all, to save money, for crops and animals, to protect sources.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Slide the same block down a ramp covered with different surfaces. It travels a shorter distance on rough surfaces than on smooth ones.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for method, 1 mark for observation and 1 mark for conclusion.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Brush at least twice a day, limit sweets and sugary drinks, visit a dentist, use clean toothbrush or chewing stick.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sorting separates plastics, metals, glass, paper and food waste so each can be recycled, reused or composted without contaminating the others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for sorting, 1 mark for recycling, 1 mark for composting, 1 mark for clear link.
